Simple Keyboard Checks Every Business Website Should Pass

2026-04-18 3 min read

Keyboard testing is one of the fastest ways to find serious usability problems on forms, menus, dialogs, and calls to action.

If a user cannot move through your navigation, buttons, forms, and popups using only the keyboard, the site already has real accessibility barriers. This affects users who cannot use a mouse as well as many screen reader users.

A quick first check is to press Tab from the top of the page and confirm that focus stays visible, the order makes sense, and every important action can be reached. If the keyboard gets trapped or disappears, that needs attention quickly.

Even small businesses can improve a lot by checking focus states, skip links, menu behavior, modal dialogs, and form validation with the keyboard before launch.
